Class ExpenseManager

java.lang.Object
masroofy.core.ExpenseManager
public class ExpenseManager extends Object
Expense operations used by history flows (US #2, #7, #8, #9).

Persistence rule: any add/edit/delete is saved immediately to SQLite.

    • filterHistory

      public List<Expense> filterHistory(AppState state, Integer categoryId, LocalDate fromDate, LocalDate toDate)
      Filters transaction history by optional category and optional inclusive date range (US #9).

      Passing null for a filter means "all" for that field. Results are returned newest first, matching the normal history order.

      Parameters:
      state - current application state
      categoryId - category id to match, or null for all categories
      fromDate - first accepted transaction date, or null for no lower bound
      toDate - last accepted transaction date, or null for no upper bound
      Returns:
      matching transactions sorted descending by timestamp

    • filterHistory

      public List<Expense> filterHistory(AppState state, Integer categoryId, String fromDateIso, String toDateIso)
      Parses optional ISO dates and filters transaction history by category/date range (US #9).
      Parameters:
      state - current application state
      categoryId - category id to match, or null for all categories
      fromDateIso - first accepted date in DD MM YYYY, blank/null for no lower bound
      toDateIso - last accepted date in DD MM YYYY, blank/null for no upper bound
      Returns:
      matching transactions sorted descending by timestamp
